column1: # OE_STRUCTURE_UNITS v1.4.0 — the named units (nested folders with their own VERSION.txt) of the packages this governance tree holds. Private content: it names real packages. Read by the class reader (oe_structure_classes); each row adds its unit= token to the row of the same class in OE_STRUCTURE_CLASSES (oe-method/04-documentation). A folder is a unit only when it is a whole folder of its own; a file that shares its folder with other content cannot be one.
